items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: My mother didn't want me to do it... she said, well you're grown now and I can't tell you what to do.

ctx.x: My mother didn't want me to do it but after she saw that I was just headlong to do it, she said, well you're grown now and I can't tell you what to do. But that's your father's wish for you never to play a wind instrument. Why don't you play a string instrument? I told her that I don't like a string instrument.
